status: Written BEFORE public validation was opened. Validation has never been loaded by any research code. Supersedes v1 because the carry core now ranks a 21-session mean score (decision_record_2_carry_denoise.json).
procedure: Run starter/backtester.py --split validation once at cost multipliers 1.0, 1.5 and 2.0. No change to code or config afterwards, whatever the result.

honest_trial_count.note: Engine runs include sensitivity grids and reference models; distinct configurations actually used for SELECTION are far fewer (combined vs carry-only; the declared de-noising criterion over 6 rules).
honest_trial_count.log_note: trial_log.csv mixes two row schemas (full metrics rows and short de-noising rows); count is raw data lines.

expectations_stated_in_advance.sampling_noise: 132 sessions gives an annualised Sharpe standard error of about 1.4. Any validation Sharpe between roughly -1 and +4.5 is consistent with development (full-dev 1.66).
expectations_stated_in_advance.expected_level: Our central expectation is closer to the full-development Sharpe (1.66) than the 2023-24 figure (2.44), because part of the 2023-24 gross gain from smoothing had no mechanism behind it.
expectations_stated_in_advance.what_would_worry_us: A drawdown well beyond the development maximum of -3.4%, any constraint-adjustment day, or turnover far from ~8 per year (a behaviour change rather than noise).
